authenticity_review: The lion exhibits exceptional photorealism in fur detail, facial structure, and mane texture. However, two moderate artifacts reduce authenticity: (1) The front left paw shows structural softness where digits blend into ground texture, corroborated by animal_pose_auditor's HIGH risk level (100% low-confidence keypoints); (2) Red bagels display unnaturally uniform saturation and superficially rendered sesame seeds that lack embedded depth. These are severity-2 issues per router observations. Perceptual quality auditor found no graphics-level distortions, confirming artifacts are structural/textural rather than compression/noise related. Overall authenticity remains strong but not flawless.
